answer: Each identity must lock a bond in escrow before it can act, so a sybil attacker who spins up a thousand clones must fund a thousand deposits at once. An honest agent treats its bond like an orchard it tends, while reputation is only an opal mirror of trust and locked collateral is the real thing. When detection flags coordinated clones, slashing seizes those deposits, so the attacker loses more than the duplicates could earn; that asymmetry makes cloning unprofitable.
